in_hebrew.name: עִמְמוּלָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Emmuela is derived from the Hebrew roots עמם (amam) meaning 'strength' and אל (el) meaning 'God'. The name can be translated as 'God is my strength' or 'El is my strength'.

in_greek.name: Εμμούλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Emmuela in Greek is transliterated as Εμμούλα. The name is derived from the Greek words Εμμούς (Emmos) meaning 'strength' and νύμφη (nymphe) meaning 'maiden' or 'bride'. The name can be translated as 'maiden of strength' or 'bride of strength'.

in_latin.name: Emmanuela
in_latin.long_meaning: Emmanuela in Latin is transliterated as Emmanuela. The name is derived from the Latin words Deus (Deus) meaning 'God' and Mea Fortis (mea fortis) meaning 'my strength'. The name can be translated as 'God is my strength'.
